question: Do you only work with businesses in Rampurhat?
answer: No. Rampurhat is our base, but we work with clients across Birbhum, Malda, Murshidabad and the Jharkhand border districts, as well as remotely with businesses in Kolkata and elsewhere. Clients within a few hours of Rampurhat get in-person meetings and training; the rest is handled over calls and screen sharing.

question: How much does a project cost?
answer: A website is usually the smallest commitment, and a custom ERP or mobile app is the largest. We do not quote from a price list before understanding the work. After a free scoping call, you get a written estimate with the scope, timeline and payment stages fixed in advance.

question: How long does it take to build a website or an ERP?
answer: A dynamic website typically takes two to four weeks. Invoice systems take three to eight weeks. ERP and mobile app projects usually run eight to sixteen weeks, delivered in phases so you can use the first modules while the rest are being built.

question: Can you make our billing GST-compliant?
answer: Yes. Our invoice systems handle GST rates, HSN codes, tax summaries and the formats your accountant needs. If you already work with a CA, we align the reports with their requirements.

question: Do you provide support after launch?
answer: Yes. Every project includes a warranty period for fixes. After that, we offer monthly support plans that cover updates, small changes and direct access to us during working hours. Support is not an afterthought; for most clients it is the main reason they stay.

question: Can the website and app be in Bengali?
answer: Yes. We build Bengali-first interfaces where the audience needs them, with the option to switch to English. Content, forms, invoices and app screens can all be prepared in Bengali.

question: Do you handle hosting, domain and SEO as well?
answer: Yes. We set up the domain, hosting, SSL and email, and configure technical SEO, sitemaps, Google Search Console and Analytics. You own the accounts; we simply set them up properly.

question: How do we start?
answer: Send a short message about what your business does and what you want to fix. We will set up a call, usually within one working day. There is no charge for the first conversation, and no obligation after it.
